title: Strands Agents Tools environment tool lets prompt injection disable secret masking
summary: The model-controlled masked parameter can expose environment secrets through the environment tool. Injected instructions can cause unmasked values to be returned and passed through other tools.

severity.rationale: Untrusted content can cause credential disclosure without operator consent for reads. Credential exposure warrants a 72-hour response in agent environments.

exposure: Requires an agent loading the environment tool and processing attacker-influenced content. The attack exposes secrets present in the agent process environment.

remediation.details: Upgrade to 0.8.6 or later, or remove the environment tool pending upgrade. Rotate credentials present in environments whose agents loaded this tool.
remediation.risk: Medium. Tool removal and credential rotation can disrupt agents.

verification: Confirm version 0.8.6 or later and that the model cannot control masking; verify credential rotation.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
